_doc: Microsoft Paint (Windows 11) at 1920x1080, display scale 100%, Paint maximised, zoom 100%, dark or light theme. Screen pixels. Re-derive on another resolution / DPI with the calibration procedure (references/calibration.md) and save as ui.json in the job folder (or pass --ui).

recorded.fitted_on: recorded runs (screen recording with ffmpeg at 30 fps running): the 4 cells of the split-face grid (593 s total; 9,195 one-pixel dots took 345 s) and the 17,386-stroke master run (512 s); max error 11 %. per_fill_s (0.10) is a placeholder until speed-calib measures it.

unrecorded.fitted_on: 9 unrecorded live runs 2026-10-24, mean error 5 %, max 17 %

_doc_timing: Estimates use timing_profiles[timing_profile] ('recorded' by default: demo runs are recorded and run slower, short strokes and dots most). plan refuses a single plan whose estimate exceeds its --seconds cap (480 by default); --profile unrecorded for runs without a screen recorder.
